skill.summary: Guides you in creating step-by-step DIY craft projects tailored to your skill level, materials, time, and budget with safety and troubleshooting tips.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Craft DIY Maker skill.

- Guides users from idea to step-by-step DIY craft project plans.
- Supports a wide range of crafts: woodworking, textiles, paper, pottery, upcycling, jewelry, leather, candle & soap making.
- Project planning includes material selection, time/difficulty estimates, tool lists, safety notes, and adaptable instructions.
- Provides troubleshooting, quick project ideas, and personalized suggestions based on user skill, tools, and materials.
- Emphasizes safety best practices for all craft activities.
